name: crowd-annotation-platform
description: Text annotation platform that keeps model drafts and human labels apart: claims with leases, redundancy and agreement, review, LLM pre-labelling, export, and a student model trained on what comes out.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @crowd/server" "npm run dev -w @crowd/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @crowd/web && npm run build -w @crowd/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @crowd/shared && npm run test -w @crowd/server && npm run test -w @crowd/web
